assets.name: stalk
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent painterly cat animation sprite atlas. References 1 approved cream-white cat identity; 2 existing jump atlas (cell 0 is neutral stand, cell 3 ascending pounce, cell 6 landing); 3 existing run atlas (cell 0 contact pose). EXACTLY EIGHT full-cat poses in strict equal FOUR columns TWO rows on ONE 2:1 landscape transparent PNG. Fixed right-facing three-quarter side view, same head size and anatomy in all cells. Preserve blue-gray eyes, round cream face, warm gray fur planes, angular hand-painted brushwork. True alpha, no scenery, ground shadow, text, grid, checkerboard or other subjects. Each complete cat WITH TAIL must fit inside central 70% width of its own cell; at least 12% clear margins on every edge. Shared paw baseline at 80% cell height, constant scale, do not individually resize to fit. No cut off paws/tails, no overlap between cells. Action: lowering into a hunting crouch and peeking up from cover. Eight ordered poses: 0 match neutral standing reference; 1 bend elbows and hind knees, lower shoulders; 2 lower belly halfway toward ground, gather hind legs; 3 deep hunting crouch, belly near ground, head low at back level, ears alert, tail laid behind. 4 keep same crouched body but raise head a little to peek; 5 raise head further and look intently forward/upward; 6 head fully raised for watchful stalking, torso and belly stay low; 7 almost identical to 6, only tail tip subtly curls, same head and body registration. This is tense alert quadruped hunting, not a relaxed loaf or seated cat. No vegetation. First half bridges stand to crouch, second half only the head emerges above imaginary grass.
assets.correctionPrompt: Edit this exact eight-pose cat animation atlas. All tail tips, paws and whiskers must remain at least 12% of cell width away from both side edges, with fully clear transparent gutters. Same physical scale across cells, no enlargement of shorter poses, no crop. Align paws to 82% of cell height. Do not introduce background, labels, checkerboard, shadows or grid. True alpha. assets.name: perch
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent butterfly landing/takeoff atlas matching the reference eight-pose apricot-yellow wingbeat sheet. SAME butterfly identity, cream scalloped edges, warm brown spots and veins, olive-brown slender body, same hand-painted matte angular strokes. ONE 2:1 landscape image, exactly EIGHT isolated sprites in strict FOUR columns TWO rows with equal cells. True alpha, no flowers or scenery, no shadow, checkerboard, text, ground or grid. Wide transparent gutters, every tip inside central 68% of cell width. Fixed front-upper three-quarter camera; body axis vertical, head at top, body size and thorax position identical in every cell, no body rotations or individual scaling. TOP ROW FOUR FRAME LANDING: 0 near-open airborne wings matching reference pose 7, tiny legs starting to extend; 1 legs extend to an imaginary perch, wings halfway raised; 2 feet now resting on an imaginary perch, wings mostly folded upright; 3 fully settled with wings upright folded, feet resting, alert antennae. BOTTOM ROW FOUR FRAME TAKEOFF: 4 same settled pose as 3; 5 wings open partway while feet still supporting; 6 wings spread, body ready to lift, feet begin curling; 7 wings fully spread matching reference pose 0, legs tucked again. Keep body at same pixel height; code will move the butterfly during landing/takeoff. Clearly depict a few tiny gripping leg tips below the body so a contact point can be registered. No plant under the butterfly.
